content.label: Examiner note - weak means PARTIALLY ionised
content.body: Ethanoic acid's pH sits around 3-5: it is a weak acid because only a small fraction of its molecules ionise in water - an equilibrium, not a full split. Weak does NOT mean unreactive: the H+ ions that ARE produced still react with metals (slow bubbles of hydrogen) and carbonates (fizzing of CO2), just as any acid does. 'Weak' and 'dilute' are different words - do not swap them.
